Website check

Have your website checked for free against 100 points in nine areas, from security, legal notice and privacy to mobile, Google, forms, maps, booking and WhatsApp. For every point you learn in plain words how the check works and what to do.

  • 100checkpoints
  • 9areas
  • 10critical
  • €0free

Instant check

Enter your address. In about 15 seconds you see how your website does on 100 checkpoints, what to fix first and why. Free, no sign-up, nothing stored.

Nine areas, 100 points

The check sees your website the way visitors, browsers and Google see it. It looks at the homepage, contact page and subpages, along with redirects, certificate, embedded services and the public records of your domain.

  1. 01

    Security

    Encryption, certificate, the server’s protection settings, secure cookies and no outdated system.

    15 points · 2 critical
  2. 02

    Legal and privacy

    Legal notice with required details, privacy policy, third-party services only after consent, notices on forms.

    11 points · 3 critical
  3. 03

    Address and reachability

    One address with and without www, no detours, no test addresses, no broken links, a helpful error page.

    10 points · 1 critical
  4. 04

    Mobile and display

    Set up for phones, zooming allowed, nothing shifts or sticks out, icons for the tab and home screen.

    9 points · 1 critical
  5. 05

    Google and visibility

    Title, description, headings, sitemap, location, business data for Google and a title of its own for each subpage.

    20 points · 2 critical
  6. 06

    Speed

    Response time, loading time, compression, caching, blocking scripts and the speed of subpages.

    10 points
  7. 07

    Contact and trust

    Contact from the homepage, tap-to-call, a clear next step, reviews and a well-maintained impression.

    8 points · 1 critical
  8. 08

    Integrations and interfaces

    Form with spam protection, online booking, map, WhatsApp, videos, social media, Google profile, newsletter, chat and shop.

    11 points
  9. 09

    Domain email

    Your domain receives email, and SPF and DMARC protect against people writing in your name.

    6 points

What the check typically finds

Much of this goes unnoticed day to day, but it costs visitors, trust or, in the worst case, a formal legal warning.

  • Address

    The address jumps around

    Anyone typing your address ends up on a third-party site-builder address via several detours. That confuses visitors and Google.

    your-company.com→http://www.your-company.com→your-company.builder.site

    ✕
  • Privacy

    Google loads without consent

    Fonts, maps or videos from Google load before visitors agree. In Germany this has already led to waves of legal warnings.

    • fonts.googleapis.combefore consent
    • maps.googleapis.combefore consent
    • youtube.com/embedbefore consent
    ✕
  • Mobile

    Content sticks out at the edge

    A table or image with a fixed width pushes the page sideways on a phone. Visitors have to swipe back and forth.

    ✕
  • Security

    Certificate expires soon

    Without automatic renewal, the browser will show a warning page instead of your website within days.

    Certificate for your-company.comexpires in 9 daysAutomatic renewal is off

    ✕

The ten critical points

If one of them is missing, you lose visitors, trust or risk a formal warning. Critical points count five times in the result.

  1. Secure connection with a valid certificateWithout a valid certificate the browser shows “Not secure” or blocks the site. Many visitors leave straight away.
  2. Old address redirects to the secure oneAnyone typing your address without https or following an old link otherwise lands on an insecure page. Google then counts two versions.
  3. Legal notice one click awayFor business websites in Germany the legal notice is mandatory. If it is missing or hidden, legal warnings are likely.
  4. Privacy policy reachableEvery website processes data, if only through the server. The GDPR therefore requires a privacy policy.
  5. No third-party services without consentThese services learn your visitors’ IP addresses. Without consent this is not allowed, and it has already led to waves of legal warnings.
  6. One clear address, with and without “www”Two separate versions confuse Google and visitors. If the site ends up on another domain, it looks dubious.
  7. Set up for phonesOver half of visitors use a phone. Without this setting a tiny desktop page appears.
  8. Meaningful page titleThe title decides whether your site is found and clicked on Google.
  9. Open to GoogleA blocked site does not appear on Google at all. This often happens when the block is forgotten after a relaunch.
  10. Contact directly from the homepageAnyone who cannot see right away how to reach you goes to the competition.

All 100 checkpoints

Every point has an info button that explains in plain words how the check works and what to do. Points that do not apply to your website are shown as “not applicable” and do not lower the overall score, so a site without a shop is not rated on shop points.

  • Critical10

    If one is missing, you lose visitors straight away or risk a formal warning. Counts five times.

  • Important30

    Costs noticeable trust, visibility on Google or inquiries. Counts twice.

  • Recommended60

    Turns a good website into a very good one. Counts once.

Security15 points
  1. CriticalSecure connection with a valid certificateWithout a valid certificate the browser shows “Not secure” or blocks the site. Many visitors leave straight away.
    How the check works
    The check opens your homepage with https:// and checks whether the browser accepts the certificate without a warning.
    What to do
    Activate a free Let’s Encrypt certificate at your host and switch on automatic renewal.

    I fix this as a one-off repair, usually in under an hour.

  2. CriticalOld address redirects to the secure oneAnyone typing your address without https or following an old link otherwise lands on an insecure page. Google then counts two versions.
    How the check works
    The check opens your address with http:// (without s) and checks whether the server permanently redirects to https://.
    What to do
    Set up a permanent redirect (code 301) from http to https, usually a switch at the host.

    I fix this as a one-off repair, usually in under an hour.

  3. ImportantCertificate is valid long enoughIf the certificate expires, every visitor sees a warning page instead of your website until someone renews it.
    How the check works
    The check reads the expiry date of your certificate and checks whether it is valid for at least 21 more days.
    What to do
    Check and switch on automatic renewal at your host.

    I take care of this in website maintenance from €29 per month.

  4. ImportantCertificate covers all addressesIf one variant is missing, some visitors see a security warning depending on how they type the address.
    How the check works
    The check tests whether the certificate is issued for your address with and without “www”.
    What to do
    Have the certificate issued for both variants.

    I fix this as a one-off repair, usually in under an hour.

  5. ImportantBrowsers remember the secure connectionWith it the browser always opens your site encrypted, even on public Wi-Fi. An attacker can then not quietly redirect the connection.
    How the check works
    The check reads your server’s response and looks for the “Strict-Transport-Security” (HSTS) instruction of at least 30 days.
    What to do
    Add one line to the server settings.

    I fix this as a one-off repair, usually in under an hour.

  6. ImportantAll images and files load securelyInsecurely loaded files break the padlock in the browser or are not shown at all.
    How the check works
    The check looks on the homepage for images, scripts and videos still embedded via http:// instead of https://.
    What to do
    Switch the addresses of the affected files to https://.

    I fix this as a one-off repair, usually in under an hour.

  7. ImportantSite cannot be embedded secretlyOtherwise a foreign site can overlay yours invisibly and trick visitors into clicks they did not intend.
    How the check works
    The check looks for the instruction that your site may not be embedded in other sites (X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors).
    What to do
    Add one line to the server settings.

    I fix this as a one-off repair, usually in under an hour.

  8. RecommendedFiles are not misinterpretedIt stops the browser from running a harmless file as a program. That closes a well-known attack gap.
    How the check works
    The check looks in your server’s response for the “X-Content-Type-Options” instruction with the value “nosniff”.
    What to do
    Add one line to the server settings.

    I fix this as a one-off repair, usually in under an hour.

  9. RecommendedRules for where content may come fromIf foreign code ever gets onto the site, the browser blocks it. That is strong protection against data theft.
    How the check works
    The check looks for a “Content-Security-Policy”, a list of the addresses that scripts, images and fonts may be loaded from.
    What to do
    Set up a suitable policy and test it so nothing wanted gets blocked.

    I take care of this in website maintenance from €29 per month.

  10. RecommendedVisited addresses are not passed onWithout a rule, full addresses, for example with search or form data, can end up at other sites.
    How the check works
    The check looks for a “Referrer-Policy” that defines how much of the current address is passed to other sites.
    What to do
    Add one line to the server settings.

    I fix this as a one-off repair, usually in under an hour.

  11. RecommendedCamera, microphone and location lockedEmbedded third-party content can then not secretly request these features.
    How the check works
    The check looks for a “Permissions-Policy” that switches off unneeded features such as camera, microphone or location.
    What to do
    Add one line to the server settings.

    I fix this as a one-off repair, usually in under an hour.

  12. RecommendedNo software versions visibleVersion numbers show attackers which known flaws they can try.
    How the check works
    The check tests whether your server or system reveals version numbers such as “Apache 2.4” or “WordPress 6.1”.
    What to do
    Switch off the version display in server and system.

    I fix this as a one-off repair, usually in under an hour.

  13. RecommendedContact for security reportsAnyone who finds a flaw then knows whom to tell before someone exploits it.
    How the check works
    The check tests whether the file “/.well-known/security.txt” exists, stating where security flaws can be reported.
    What to do
    Create a short text file with an email address and expiry date.

    I take care of this in website maintenance from €29 per month.

  14. RecommendedCookies are protected against snoopingUnprotected cookies, for example for logins, are easier to steal.
    How the check works
    If your homepage sets cookies, the check tests whether they are only sent encrypted (“Secure”) and locked for scripts (“HttpOnly”).
    What to do
    Adjust the cookie settings in the system or on the server.

    I fix this as a one-off repair, usually in under an hour.

  15. RecommendedNo outdated system visibleOutdated systems are the most common way websites get hacked.
    How the check works
    If your site reveals a website builder or CMS with a version (e.g. WordPress), the check compares the version with the current release.
    What to do
    Update the system, plugins and themes and keep them maintained.

    I take care of this in website maintenance from €29 per month.

Legal and privacy11 points
  1. CriticalLegal notice one click awayFor business websites in Germany the legal notice is mandatory. If it is missing or hidden, legal warnings are likely.
    How the check works
    The check looks for a “legal notice” (Impressum) link on the homepage and opens the page.
    What to do
    Create a legal notice and link it from every page, ideally in the footer.

    I handle the technical side. The content of legal texts is best checked by a legal-text service or a lawyer.

  2. CriticalPrivacy policy reachableEvery website processes data, if only through the server. The GDPR therefore requires a privacy policy.
    How the check works
    The check looks for a “privacy” link on the homepage and opens the page.
    What to do
    Create a privacy policy that matches the services actually used and link it everywhere.

    I handle the technical side. The content of legal texts is best checked by a legal-text service or a lawyer.

  3. CriticalNo third-party services without consentThese services learn your visitors’ IP addresses. Without consent this is not allowed, and it has already led to waves of legal warnings.
    How the check works
    The check tests which third-party services load on the very first visit, for example Google Fonts, Google Analytics, Facebook, YouTube or Google Maps.
    What to do
    Host fonts on your own server and load maps, videos and statistics only after consent.

    I take care of this in website maintenance from €29 per month.

  4. ImportantConsent before statistics and adsStatistics and advertising need prior consent. Without it, fines are possible.
    How the check works
    If the check finds statistics or advertising services, it checks whether a consent (cookie) banner is in place.
    What to do
    Set up a consent banner or switch to cookie-free statistics.

    I take care of this in website maintenance from €29 per month.

  5. ImportantLegal notice has the required detailsA legal notice without an address or quick way of contact counts as incomplete and can be challenged.
    How the check works
    In the legal notice the check looks for an address with postcode and an email address.
    What to do
    Add name, full address, email and, if applicable, register entry and VAT ID.

    I handle the technical side. The content of legal texts is best checked by a legal-text service or a lawyer.

  6. ImportantNo advertising cookies before consentSuch cookies may only be set after consent.
    How the check works
    The check tests which cookies your homepage sets immediately and looks for known statistics and advertising cookies (e.g. from Google or Facebook).
    What to do
    Configure the services to start only after consent.

    I take care of this in website maintenance from €29 per month.

  7. ImportantForms send encryptedNames, email addresses and messages may only be transmitted encrypted.
    How the check works
    For all forms on the homepage and contact page the check tests where they send entries.
    What to do
    Switch the form address to https://.

    I fix this as a one-off repair, usually in under an hour.

  8. RecommendedLegal texts cite current lawsOutdated references look neglected and suggest other texts may no longer be correct either.
    How the check works
    The check reads the legal notice and checks whether it still cites the Telemedia Act (TMG), replaced in 2024, instead of the Digital Services Act (DDG).
    What to do
    Update the reference to § 5 DDG and review the legal texts as a whole.

    I handle the technical side. The content of legal texts is best checked by a legal-text service or a lawyer.

  9. RecommendedForm with privacy noticeAnyone entering data must learn what happens to it. That also builds trust.
    How the check works
    If there is a form, the check looks for a privacy notice or checkbox next to it.
    What to do
    Add a short sentence linking to the privacy policy above the send button.

    I fix this as a one-off repair, usually in under an hour.

  10. RecommendedLegal texts linked on every pageThe legal notice must be “easily recognisable and directly accessible” from every page, not only the homepage.
    How the check works
    The check opens several subpages and checks whether the legal notice and privacy policy are linked there too.
    What to do
    Put both links in the shared footer of all pages.

    I fix this as a one-off repair, usually in under an hour.

  11. RecommendedAccessibility statement (for shops)Since June 2025, the German Accessibility Act requires this for many online shops and consumer bookings.
    How the check works
    If the check detects an online shop or paid booking, it looks for an accessibility statement.
    What to do
    Check whether the law applies to you, make the site more accessible and publish a statement.

    I handle the technical side. The content of legal texts is best checked by a legal-text service or a lawyer.

Address and reachability10 points
  1. CriticalOne clear address, with and without “www”Two separate versions confuse Google and visitors. If the site ends up on another domain, it looks dubious.
    How the check works
    The check opens your address with and without “www” and checks whether both lead to the same site and not to a foreign domain.
    What to do
    Choose one variant and permanently redirect the other to it.

    I fix this as a one-off repair, usually in under an hour.

  2. ImportantNo detours to the homepageEvery detour costs loading time. More than two point to a messy setup.
    How the check works
    The check counts how many redirects it takes to reach your homepage.
    What to do
    Set up the redirects so every address leads straight to the target.

    I fix this as a one-off repair, usually in under an hour.

  3. ImportantNo foreign or test addressesSuch addresses look unprofessional and can send visitors or Google to the wrong place.
    How the check works

Frequently asked questions about the website check

What exactly does the check look at?

It checks the 100 points from nine areas listed in full above. These are security, legal and privacy, address and reachability, mobile and display, Google and visibility, speed, contact and trust, integrations and interfaces, and the email records of your domain. Only what any visitor can see from outside is checked.

What do Critical, Important and Recommended mean?

Critical are the ten points where you lose visitors straight away or risk a formal warning, such as a missing legal notice or an insecure connection. Important are 30 points that noticeably cost trust, visibility on Google or inquiries. Recommended are 60 points that turn a good website into a very good one. In the overall score, critical points count five times, important ones twice and recommended ones once.

What do you check under integrations and interfaces?

This covers everything that connects your website with other services, such as contact form and spam protection, online booking, Google map, WhatsApp or messenger, videos, social media profiles, Google profile and reviews, newsletter with confirmation, chat widgets and a shop with terms and cancellation policy. Whether third-party services load only after consent is especially important.

How do I know how a point is checked?

Every point has an info button. It explains in plain words how the check works, why the point matters and what to do. In the result, every missing point also says how I can solve it.

Is my address or the result stored?

Not with the instant check. The result only appears in your browser. To prevent abuse, the server keeps a non-reversible checksum of your IP address for at most one hour to limit the number of checks. Only when you request the result sheet below the result and submit the form do I receive your details together with the checked address, the score and the missing points.

Does the check replace legal advice?

No. It shows, for example, whether the legal notice and privacy policy are linked and whether third-party services load before consent. Only a lawyer can say with certainty whether the texts are correct.

Why do some points say “not applicable” or “could not be checked”?

Not every point applies to every website. If your site has no shop, for example, it needs no cancellation policy, so the point says “not applicable”. “Could not be checked” means a point could not be determined this time, for example because the server did not respond or a requirement is missing. The count is always out of 100, and neither lowers the overall score.

What does it cost to fix the points?

Many points are a server setting done in minutes, others take more work. I fix single points as a one-off repair, ongoing care is covered by website maintenance from €29 per month, and with a new website in 7 days all points are done from the start. I tell you the price beforehand.

 * Lou Digital – 50-Punkte-Website-Check (Version 2, 27.10.2026)
 * POST url=…&sprache=de|en&modus=sofort|voll

# Büro Synodos & Lou Digital (V20) – eigene Regeln für diesen Ordner
# Startdatei des Büros (die Hauptseite nutzt start.html)
DirectoryIndex index.html
<IfModule mod_headers.c>
# Die Sicherheitsregeln stehen in der Seite selbst (Prüfsummen für Skripte, Verbindung nur zur Büro-Schnittstelle).
# Hier nur ergänzen, was in der Seite nicht geht, und die strengere Regel der Hauptseite ersetzen.
Header always set Content-Security-Policy "frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'"
Header always set X-Frame-Options "DENY"
Header always set Cache-Control "no-store"
Header always set X-Robots-Tag "noindex, nofollow"
</IfModule>

@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme=light]){--bg:#0e0e10;--surface:#17171a;--surface2:#1c1c20;--hover:#202025;--sel:#26262c;--ink:#f2f2f3;--ink2:#dcdcdf;--ink-rgb:242,242,243;--muted:#a6a6ae;--faint:#8e8e97;--line:#2a2a30;--line2:#3b3b42;--btn:#f2f2f3;--btn-ink:#111111;--btn-hover:#d6d6da;--focus:rgba(242,242,243,.18);
--ok:#7fd1a3;--ok-bg:#16291f;--warn:#e9c072;--warn-bg:#2d2412;--err:#f29b90;--err-bg:#331b18;--info-bg:#212126;--c1:#f2f2f3;--c2:#5d5d66;--c3:#a6a6ae;--grid:#28282e;--shadow:none}}
:root[data-theme=dark]{--bg:#0e0e10;--surface:#17171a;--surface2:#1c1c20;--hover:#202025;--sel:#26262c;--ink:#f2f2f3;--ink2:#dcdcdf;--ink-rgb:242,242,243;--muted:#a6a6ae;--faint:#8e8e97;--line:#2a2a30;--line2:#3b3b42;--btn:#f2f2f3;--btn-ink:#111111;--btn-hover:#d6d6da;--focus:rgba(242,242,243,.18);
--ok:#7fd1a3;--ok-bg:#16291f;--warn:#e9c072;--warn-bg:#2d2412;--err:#f29b90;--err-bg:#331b18;--info-bg:#212126;--c1:#f2f2f3;--c2:#5d5d66;--c3:#a6a6ae;--grid:#28282e;--shadow:none}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{font-size:100%;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 .9375rem/1.5 var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;font-feature-settings:"tnum" 0}
h1,h2,h3{font-weight:650;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:0;line-height:1.25}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
a{color:var(--ink);text-underline-offset:2px}
.hidden,[hidden]{display:none !important}
body:not(.ist-admin) .nur-admin{display:none !important}
.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}
.ico{width:18px;height:18px;flex:0 0 auto;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:2px}
/* ---------- Marke (neutral) ---------- */
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--ink);min-width:0}
.mono{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 1rem/1 var(--sans);flex:0 0 auto;letter-spacing:0}
.brand b{display:block;font:650 1.05rem/1.15 var(--sans)}
.brand small{display:block;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.02em;margin-top:1px;white-space:nowrap}
/* Bereiche: monochrom unterschieden (● Synodos, ○ Lou Digital) */
.bm{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.35em;font:600 .7rem/1.3 var(--sans);padding:.08em .5em;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap;vertical-align:middle;border:1px solid var(--line2);color:var(--ink2);background:var(--surface)}
.bm::before{content:"";width:.52em;height:.52em;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto;box-sizing:border-box}
.bm.synodos::before{background:var(--ink)}.bm.lou::before{border:1.5px solid var(--ink);background:transparent}.bm.alle::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ink) 50%,transparent 50%);border:1.5px solid var(--ink)}
.bereich{display:inline-flex;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:2px;gap:2px}
.bereich button{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);padding:.32rem .7rem;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font:550 .84rem var(--sans);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4em;white-space:nowrap}
.bereich button:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.bereich button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line2)}
.bereich button[data-bereich]::before{content:"";width:.55em;height:.55em;border-radius:50%;box-sizing:border-box}
.bereich button[data-bereich=synodos]::before{background:currentColor}.bereich button[data-bereich=lou]::before{border:1.5px solid currentColor}.bereich button[data-bereich=alle]::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,currentColor 50%,transparent 50%);border:1.5px solid currentColor}
.balken{height:6px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--line);overflow:hidden;margin:6px 0 4px}.balken i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--ink);border-radius:inherit}
.balken.warn i{background:var(--warn)}.balken.err i{background:var(--err)}
/* ---------- Anmeldung ---------- */
.gate{min-height:100vh;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:24px 16px}
.gate-card{width:100%;max-width:420px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:30px 28px 26px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.gate .brand{margin-bottom:24px}
.gate h1{font-size:1.35rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.gate p{margin:0 0 18px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem}
.field{display:block;margin:0 0 12px;min-width:0}
.field span{display:block;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:5px}
.field input,.field select,.field textarea{width:100%;padding:.58rem .75rem;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r2);background:var(--surface);outline:none;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s;min-width:0}
.field input:focus,.field select:focus,.field textarea:focus{border-color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--focus)}
.field input[disabled],.field select[disabled],.field textarea[disabled]{opacity:.65;background:var(--surface2)}
.field textarea{min-height:100px;resize:vertical}
.field.check{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.field.check input{width:auto}.field.check span{margin:0;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink)}
.code input{font-size:1.45rem;letter-spacing:.35em;text-align:center;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-family:var(--mono)}
.invite input{font-size:1.15rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-align:center;text-transform:uppercase;font-family:var(--mono)}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.45em;white-space:nowrap;padding:.56rem 1rem;border-radius:var(--r2);border:1px solid var(--btn);background:var(--btn);color:var(--btn-ink);font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color .15s,border-color .15s,opacity .15s}
.btn:hover{background:var(--btn-hover);border-color:var(--btn-hover)}
.btn[disabled]{opacity:.45;cursor:default}
.btn.ghost{background:var(--surface);border-color:var(--line2);color:var(--ink)}
.btn.ghost:hover{background:var(--hover);border-color:var(--ink)}
.btn.mini{padding:.34rem .7rem;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:550}
.btn.danger{background:var(--surface);border-color:var(--line2);color:var(--err)}
.btn.danger:hover{border-color:var(--err);background:var(--err-bg)}
.btn.wide{width:100%}
.link{background:none;border:0;padding:0;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px;cursor:pointer;font-size:inherit}
.msg{margin:12px 0 0;padding:.6rem .8rem;border-radius:var(--r2);font-size:.9rem;display:none}
.msg.err{display:block;background:var(--err-bg);color:var(--err)}
.msg.ok{display:block;background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok)}
.msg.info{display:block;background:var(--info-bg);color:var(--muted)}
.qr{display:grid;place-items:center;margin:8px 0 16px}
.qr canvas{border-radius:8px;background:#fff;padding:0;max-width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.secret{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.84rem;word-break:break-all;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:.55rem .75rem;border-radius:var(--r2);color:var(--ink)}
.gate footer{margin-top:22px;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--faint);text-align:center}
.gate footer a{color:var(--muted)}
.gate .links{margin:16px 0 0;text-align:center;display:grid;gap:6px}
/* ---------- App-Rahmen ---------- */
.app{min-height:100vh;display:grid;grid-template-columns:236px minmax(0,1fr);background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--surface) 235px,var(--line) 235px,var(--line) 236px,var(--bg) 236px)}
@media (min-width:961px){#b-back{display:none !important}}
.side{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--surface);border-right:1px solid var(--line);padding:16px 12px 12px;gap:14px;min-width:0}
.side .brand{padding:2px 6px 6px}
#nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;overflow:auto;flex:1;min-height:0}
#nav button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;padding:.5rem .6rem;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-weight:550;font-size:.9rem;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;white-space:nowrap}
#nav button:hover{background:var(--hover);color:var(--ink)}
#nav button[aria-current=page]{background:var(--sel);color:var(--ink)}
#nav button .lbl{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#nav .sep{height:1px;background:var(--line);margin:6px 4px}
.badge{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:1.45em;height:1.45em;padding:0 .38em;border-radius:999px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1}
.badge.leise{background:var(--line);color:var(--ink)}
.side-foot{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0}
.me{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0;flex:1}
.me .who{min-width:0;display:grid;line-height:1.2}
.me #me{font-weight:600;font-size:.88rem;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.rolle{font-size:.68rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}
.icobtn{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;flex:0 0 auto}
.icobtn:hover{background:var(--hover);border-color:var(--line2)}
.main-wrap{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:14px clamp(14px,3vw,28px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;flex-wrap:wrap}
.top h1{font-size:1.2rem}
.top-r{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.kbd{font:600 .7rem var(--mono);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-bottom-width:2px;border-radius:4px;padding:0 .32em;color:var(--muted);background:var(--surface)}
main{padding:clamp(14px,2.6vw,26px) clamp(14px,3vw,28px) 40px;max-width:1440px;width:100%;margin:0 auto;min-width:0}
.view{display:none}
.view.on{display:block}
/* ---------- Bausteine ---------- */
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:10px;margin:0 0 16px}
@media (min-width:601px){.stats.n7{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}@media (min-width:1400px){.stats.n7{grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.stat{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:12px 14px;min-width:0}
.stat b{display:block;font:650 1.45rem/1.15 var(--sans);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:-.01em;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.stat span{display:block;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
.stat small{display:block;font-size:.74rem;color:var(--faint);margin-top:2px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.stat.klick{cursor:pointer}.stat.klick:hover{border-color:var(--line2);background:var(--surface2)}
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(260px,360px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;min-height:60vh}
.split.wide-list{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(0,1fr)}
@media (max-width:960px){.split,.split.wide-list{grid-template-columns:1fr}.split.thread-open .pane-list{display:none}#post-split:not(.thread-open) .pane-thread{display:none}}
.pane{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;min-width:0;overflow:hidden}
.pane-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);flex-wrap:wrap;min-height:50px}
.pane-head h2{font-size:1rem}
.pane-head .tools{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.search{width:100%;padding:.46rem .7rem;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r2);background:var(--surface);outline:none}
.search:focus{border-color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--focus)}
select.search{width:auto;padding:.36rem .6rem}
.list{overflow:auto;flex:1;max-height:72vh}
.conv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;width:100%;padding:10px 14px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;color:inherit}
.conv:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.conv[aria-current=true]{background:var(--sel)}
.avatar{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sel);color:var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font:650 .82rem var(--sans);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.conv .nm{font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-width:0}
.conv .nm > span:first-child{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.conv .pv{font-size:.84rem;color:var(--muted);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;display:block}
.conv .tm{font-size:.74rem;color:var(--faint);white-space:nowrap;display:grid;justify-items:end;gap:4px}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.3em;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:600;padding:.08em .45em;border-radius:4px;background:var(--info-bg);color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.chip.telegram::before{content:"✈"}.chip.mail::before{content:"✉"}.chip.web::before{content:"⌂"}.chip.whatsapp::before{content:"◉"}.chip.signal::before{content:"◎"}.chip.sms::before{content:"✆"}
.chip.lang{font-family:var(--mono);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.chip.voice::before{content:"🎤"}
.kicons{display:inline-flex;gap:3px;flex:0 0 auto}.ki{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:1.3em;height:1.3em;border-radius:4px;font-size:.68rem;background:var(--info-bg);color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.ki.telegram::before{content:"✈"}.ki.mail::before{content:"✉"}.ki.web::before{content:"⌂"}.ki.whatsapp::before{content:"◉"}.ki.signal::before{content:"◎"}.ki.sms::before{content:"✆"}
.thread{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;max-height:60vh;background:var(--surface2)}
.bub{max-width:min(80%,660px);padding:.55rem .8rem;border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;font-size:.92rem}
.bub.ein{align-self:flex-start;border-bottom-left-radius:3px}
.bub.aus{align-self:flex-end;background:var(--sel);border-color:var(--line);border-bottom-right-radius:3px}
.bub .meta{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--faint);margin-top:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.bub .sub{font-weight:650;margin-bottom:4px}
.bub .kopfzeile{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;font-size:.74rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:5px;white-space:normal}
.bub .kurz{white-space:normal;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);border-left:2px solid var(--line2);padding-left:8px;margin:6px 0 0}
.bub .orig{white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:.84rem;color:var(--muted);border-top:1px dashed var(--line2);margin-top:8px;padding-top:6px}
.bub .tools{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:6px;white-space:normal}
.bub .tools button{background:none;border:0;padding:0;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px;cursor:pointer}
.bub .tools button:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.day{align-self:center;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:6px 0}
.compose{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px 14px;display:grid;gap:8px}
.compose .row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.compose select,.compose input{padding:.44rem .65rem;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r2);background:var(--surface);max-width:100%}
.compose textarea{width:100%;min-height:84px;padding:.6rem .75rem;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r2);background:var(--surface);resize:vertical}
.compose textarea:focus,.compose select:focus,.compose input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--focus)}
.quick{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 14px 0}
.quick a,.quick button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4em;padding:.28rem .65rem;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);font-size:.82rem;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
.quick a:hover,.quick button:hover{border-color:var(--ink)}
.quick .dot{width:.5em;height:.5em;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;opacity:.55}
.empty{padding:36px 20px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
.empty b{display:block;font-size:1rem;font-weight:650;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:4px}
.tblwrap{overflow-x:auto;max-width:100%}
.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.9rem}
.tbl th{text-align:left;font-size:.74rem;color:var(--muted);padding:9px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;background:var(--surface2);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1}
.tbl td{padding:9px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top}
.tbl tbody tr[data-id]{cursor:pointer}
.tbl tbody tr[data-id]:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.tbl tr[aria-current=true]{background:var(--sel)}
.tbl .num,.num{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.tbl tr.storno td{text-decoration:line-through;color:var(--faint)}
.tbl tfoot td{font-weight:650;border-bottom:0;background:var(--surface2)}
.form{padding:16px;display:grid;gap:2px;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));column-gap:14px}
.form .field.full,.form .full{grid-column:1/-1}
@media (max-width:600px){.form{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;padding:0 16px 16px;grid-column:1/-1}
.form .actions{padding:6px 0 0}
.status{display:inline-block;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;padding:.08em .5em;border-radius:4px;background:var(--info-bg);color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid transparent}
.status.angefragt,.status.entwurf,.status.eingeladen,.status.vorschlag,.status.offen{background:var(--warn-bg);color:var(--warn)}
.status.bestaetigt,.status.übergeben,.status.gültig,.status.aktiv,.status.uebernommen,.status.bezahlt{background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok)}
.status.erledigt,.status.zurückgegeben,.status.beendet,.status.verworfen{background:var(--info-bg);color:var(--muted)}
.status.abgesagt,.status.widerrufen,.status.gesperrt,.status.storniert,.status.faellig{background:var(--err-bg);color:var(--err)}
.settings{display:grid;gap:14px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,320px),1fr))}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:16px 18px;min-width:0}
.card.full{grid-column:1/-1}
.card h2{font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.card h2 .rechts{margin-left:auto;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)}
.card h3{font-size:.92rem;margin:14px 0 8px}
.card p{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 10px;font-size:.9rem}
.card .form{padding:0}
.block{margin-top:14px}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.small{font-size:.84rem}
.hint{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);margin:2px 0 10px}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:22px;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);padding:.6rem 1rem;border-radius:8px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s,transform .2s;z-index:40;max-width:90vw;font-size:.9rem;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.toast.on{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
.codebox{display:grid;gap:6px;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:14px;margin:10px 0}
.codebox b{font:650 1.3rem var(--mono);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ink)}
.dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:4px 14px;margin:0;font-size:.86rem}
.dl dt{color:var(--muted)}.dl dd{margin:0;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
/* ---------- Übersicht ---------- */
.dash{display:grid;gap:14px;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,minmax(0,1fr))}
.dash > *{grid-column:span 12}
@media (min-width:1100px){.dash .w8{grid-column:span 8}.dash .w4{grid-column:span 4}.dash .w6{grid-column:span 6}}
@media (min-width:760px) and (max-width:1099px){.dash .w6,.dash .w4{grid-column:span 6}}
.chart{width:100%;display:block;overflow:visible}
.chart text{fill:var(--muted);font:500 11px var(--sans)}
.chart .gl{stroke:var(--grid);stroke-width:1}
.chart .ax{stroke:var(--line2);stroke-width:1}
.chart .s1{fill:var(--c1)}.chart .s2{fill:var(--c2)}
.chart .ln{fill:none;stroke:var(--c3);stroke-width:2}
.chart .pt{fill:var(--surface);stroke:var(--c3);stroke-width:2}
.chart .hb{fill:transparent}.chart .hb:hover{fill:rgba(var(--ink-rgb),.05)}
.legend{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);margin:2px 0 8px}
.legend i{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:-1px}
.legend i.s1{background:var(--c1)}.legend i.s2{background:var(--c2)}.legend i.ln{height:2px;width:14px;background:var(--c3);border-radius:0;vertical-align:3px}
.hbars{display:grid;gap:8px}
.hbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(78px,110px) minmax(0,1fr) 38px;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:.84rem}
.hbar .t{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--ink2)}
.hbar .b{height:10px;background:var(--line);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}.hbar .b i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--c1);border-radius:3px}
.hbar .n{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--muted)}
.hbars.breit .hbar{grid-template-columns:minmax(110px,170px) minmax(0,1fr) 58px}
.mini-list{display:grid;gap:0}
.mini-list .it{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.88rem;cursor:pointer;background:none;border-left:0;border-right:0;border-top:0;text-align:left;width:100%;color:inherit}
.mini-list .it:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.mini-list .it:hover .t{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}
.mini-list .d{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--muted);font-size:.8rem;white-space:nowrap;min-width:84px}
.mini-list .t{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.mini-list .r{white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.frag{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.frag input{flex:1;min-width:200px;padding:.6rem .8rem;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r2);background:var(--surface);outline:none}
.frag input:focus{border-color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--focus)}
.frag-out{margin-top:12px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);background:var(--surface2);white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:.92rem;line-height:1.55}
.frag-out .stand{display:block;font-size:.74rem;color:var(--faint);margin-top:8px;white-space:normal}
.beispiele{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
.beispiele button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);color:var(--muted);border-radius:999px;padding:.2rem .65rem;font-size:.78rem;cursor:pointer}
.beispiele button:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line2)}
/* ---------- Vorschläge ---------- */
.vgrid{display:grid;gap:12px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(min(100%,340px),1fr))}
.vcard{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:14px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;min-width:0}
.vcard .k{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted)}
.vcard .typ{font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}
.vcard h3{font-size:.98rem;margin:0}
.vcard .zf{color:var(--ink2);font-size:.88rem;margin:0}
.vcard .txt{white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:.88rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:8px 10px;max-height:220px;overflow:auto}
.vcard .fehlt{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--warn);background:var(--warn-bg);border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px}
.vcard .acts{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:auto;padding-top:4px}
.vcard.erledigt{opacity:.72}
.filterbar{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px}
/* ---------- Kosten ---------- */
.kat{display:inline-block;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;padding:0 .4em;white-space:nowrap}
.ueberfaellig{color:var(--err);font-weight:600}
/* ---------- Unterschrift ---------- */
.sig{grid-column:1/-1;margin:0 0 12px}
.sig > span{display:block;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:5px}
.sig canvas{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/1;border:1.5px dashed var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r2);background:var(--surface);touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair}
.sig .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:6px;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--faint)}
.sig.locked canvas{cursor:default;border-style:solid}
/* ---------- Regeln ---------- */
.regeln{display:grid;gap:14px}
.regel-gruppe h3{font-size:.95rem;margin:0 0 8px}
.regel{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);margin:0 0 6px}
.regel summary{cursor:pointer;padding:10px 14px;font-weight:600;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:.92rem}
.regel summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.regel summary::after{content:"+";font-weight:400;color:var(--faint)}
.regel[open] summary::after{content:"–"}
.regel .txt{padding:0 14px 12px;white-space:pre-wrap;color:var(--ink2);font-size:.9rem}
.regel.aus{opacity:.6}
/* ---------- Dokument (Quittung, Rechnung, Protokoll): schlicht schwarz-weiß ---------- */
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:grid;justify-items:center;align-items:start;overflow:auto;padding:22px 12px;z-index:30}
.ov .bar{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;width:min(794px,100%);margin-bottom:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.doc{--mk:#111;background:#fff;color:#111;width:min(794px,100%);padding:44px 48px;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3);font:400 14.5px/1.55 var(--sans);position:relative}
.doc .kopf{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;align-items:flex-start;border-bottom:1px solid #d0d0d0;padding-bottom:18px;margin-bottom:22px}
.doc .kopf .wm{width:160px;height:48px;color:#111}
.doc .abs{font-size:12.5px;text-align:right;color:#444}
.doc h1{font:700 26px var(--sans);margin:0 0 14px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.doc .kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto 1fr;gap:6px 14px;margin:0 0 18px;font-size:14px}
.doc .kv dt{color:#555;font-size:12px;padding-top:2px}
.doc .kv dd{margin:0;font-weight:600}
.doc .summe{border:1.5px solid #111;border-radius:6px;padding:14px 18px;margin:0 0 18px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.doc .summe b{font:700 24px var(--sans)}
.doc .summe small{display:block;color:#444;font-size:13px}
.doc p{margin:0 0 10px}
.doc .feld{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 1fr;gap:10px;border-bottom:1px dotted #bbb;padding:8px 0}
.doc .feld span{color:#555;font-size:13px}
.doc .erhalten{font-weight:600;margin-top:16px}
.doc .ust{font-size:13px;color:#444}
.doc .text{white-space:pre-wrap}
.doc .unterschriften{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px;margin-top:34px}
.doc .us{border-top:1px solid #111;padding-top:6px;font-size:12.5px;color:#444;position:relative;min-height:20px}
.doc .us svg{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:100%;width:100%;height:80px}
.doc .fuss{margin-top:34px;font-size:11.5px;color:#666;border-top:1px solid #ddd;padding-top:10px}
.doc .stempel{position:absolute;top:40%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-14deg);border:4px solid #a52a20;color:#a52a20;font:700 46px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.12em;padding:4px 18px;border-radius:8px;opacity:.75}
.doc h2{font:650 17px var(--sans);margin:22px 0 8px}
.doc .wm-lou{font:700 28px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.01em;color:#111;padding-top:8px}
.doc .empf{font-size:14px;margin:0 0 22px;min-height:64px;white-space:pre-line}
.doc .empf small{display:block;font-size:10.5px;color:#666;margin-bottom:4px;white-space:normal}
.doc table.pos{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:8px 0 14px;font-size:14px}
.doc table.pos th{text-align:left;font-size:11.5px;color:#555;border-bottom:1.5px solid #111;padding:6px 4px}
.doc table.pos td{padding:8px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;vertical-align:top}
.doc table.pos .num{text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}
.doc table.pos tr.gesamt td{font-weight:700;border-bottom:0;border-top:1.5px solid #111}
@media (max-width:600px){.doc{padding:24px 18px}.doc .kv{grid-template-columns:auto 1fr}.doc .feld{grid-template-columns:1fr}.doc .unterschriften{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:70px}.doc .kopf{flex-direction:column}.doc .abs{text-align:left}}
@page{size:A4;margin:14mm}
@media print{body{background:#fff}body > *:not(.ov){display:none !important}.ov{position:static;background:none;padding:0;display:block;overflow:visible}.ov .bar{display:none}.doc{box-shadow:none;width:auto;padding:0;border-radius:0}}
/* ---------- Version 22: Planer, Akquise, Werkzeuge ---------- */
.seg{display:inline-flex;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:2px;gap:2px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.seg button{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);padding:.3rem .65rem;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font:550 .82rem var(--sans);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4em;white-space:nowrap}
.seg button:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.seg button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line2)}
.ptool{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px}
.ptool h2{font-size:1.05rem;min-width:0;margin-right:auto;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.ptool .nav{display:inline-flex;gap:4px}
.pfilter{margin:0 0 12px}
.pfilter button[aria-pressed=false]{text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-color:var(--line2)}
.pfilter button[aria-pressed=false] .q{opacity:.35}
/* Quellen: monochrom unterschieden (Form statt Farbe) */
.q{display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;flex:0 0 auto;box-sizing:border-box;border:1.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:50%;vertical-align:middle}
.q-eigen .q,.q.q-eigen{background:var(--ink)}
.q-einsatz .q,.q.q-einsatz{border-radius:2px;background:var(--ink)}
.q-frist .q,.q.q-frist{border-radius:0;transform:rotate(45deg) scale(.85);border-color:var(--err);background:var(--err-bg)}
.q-kosten .q,.q.q-kosten{border-radius:2px;background:transparent}
.q-akquise .q,.q.q-akquise{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ink) 50%,transparent 50%)}
.q-google .q,.q.q-google{border-style:dashed;background:transparent}
.planer{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(280px,360px);gap:14px;align-items:start}
.planer > .pane{min-height:0}
.kal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.kal .wt{font:600 .72rem var(--sans);color:var(--muted);padding:6px 8px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface2);text-align:left}
.kal .tg{min-height:104px;padding:4px 5px 6px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:0;cursor:pointer;outline-offset:-2px}
.kal .tg:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.kal .tg.fremd{background:var(--surface2)}.kal .tg.fremd .n{color:var(--faint)}
.kal .tg[aria-selected=true]{background:var(--sel)}
.kal .n{font:600 .78rem/1.6 var(--sans);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink2);padding:0 2px}
.kal .tg.ist-heute .n{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:1.6em;height:1.6em;border-radius:999px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);align-self:flex-start}
.kal .mehr{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--muted);padding:0 3px}
.pe{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;width:100%;min-width:0;border:0;background:var(--surface2);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 4px;font:500 .72rem/1.45 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;text-align:left}
.pe:hover{background:var(--line)}
.pe .z{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--muted);flex:0 0 auto}
.pe .t{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;min-width:0}
.pe.erl .t{text-decoration:line-through;color:var(--faint)}
.pe.ueber{box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 var(--err)}
.woche{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
.wtag{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:6px 8px;min-width:0;cursor:pointer}
.wtag[aria-selected=true]{border-color:var(--ink)}
.wtag.ist-heute .wkopf{color:var(--ink);font-weight:700}
.wkopf{font:600 .78rem var(--sans);color:var(--muted);padding-bottom:4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:2px}
.wtag .mini-list .it{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:0;padding:5px 0}
.wtag .mini-list .d{min-width:0}
.agenda-h{font:650 .86rem var(--sans);margin:14px 0 2px;padding-bottom:4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line2)}
.agenda-h:first-child{margin-top:0}
.agenda-h.ist-heute::after{content:"heute";margin-left:8px;font:600 .66rem var(--sans);padding:.05em .45em;border-radius:4px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);vertical-align:middle}
.mini-list .it.pz .t{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;white-space:normal}
.mini-list .it.pz .t .tt{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.mini-list .it.pz .t small{flex-basis:100%;color:var(--muted);font-size:.74rem;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.mini-list .it.pz.erl .t{color:var(--faint);text-decoration:line-through}
.ptag{padding:12px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.ptag h3{font-size:.95rem;margin:0 0 4px;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:baseline}
.ptag h3 small{color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;font-size:.78rem}
.h-neu{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:8px}
.h-neu input{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:.42rem .6rem;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r2);background:var(--surface);outline:none;font-size:.86rem}
.h-neu input:focus{border-color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--focus)}
body:not(.ist-admin) #c-woche{grid-column:1/-1}
/* Akquise */
.kanban{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:10px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:6px;align-items:start}
.kspalte{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:10px;min-width:0}
.kspalte h3{font-size:.88rem;margin:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.kspalte h3 .zahl{font:600 .7rem var(--sans);color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:999px;padding:0 .45em}
.kspalte h3 .summe{margin-left:auto;font:600 .74rem var(--sans);color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.kspalte .khilfe{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--faint);margin:2px 0 8px}
.kspalte[data-stufe=gewonnen],.kspalte[data-stufe=verloren]{opacity:.85}
.kkarten{display:grid;gap:8px}
.kspalte .leer{color:var(--faint);font-size:.8rem;margin:4px 2px}
.lead{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:9px 10px;display:grid;gap:6px;min-width:0}
.lead .kopf{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start}
.lead b{font-weight:650;font-size:.88rem;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.lead .meta{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;font-size:.74rem;color:var(--muted)}
.lead .meta a{color:var(--ink2);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.lead .acts{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.lead .acts .btn.mini{padding:.2rem .5rem;font-size:.74rem}
.score{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:2.3em;height:2.3em;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--ok);color:var(--ok);font:700 .78rem/1 var(--sans);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;flex:0 0 auto}
.score.mittel{border-color:var(--warn);color:var(--warn)}
.score.schwach{border-color:var(--err);color:var(--err)}
.score.leer{border-style:dashed;border-color:var(--line2);color:var(--faint)}
.lead-form{margin-bottom:12px}
.vl{width:min(760px,100%);max-height:none}
.vl h2{margin-bottom:12px}
.vl textarea{min-height:260px;font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.5}
.rechts{margin-left:auto}
/* Werkzeuge */
.wzgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:0 0 12px}
.wz{display:grid;gap:4px;align-content:start;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:12px 14px;cursor:pointer;position:relative}
.wz:hover{border-color:var(--line2)}
.wz.an{border-color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--ink)}
.wz input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.wz:focus-within{outline:2px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:2px}
.wz b{font-size:.95rem}
.wz span{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ink2)}
.wz small{font-size:.74rem;color:var(--muted)}
.wz-start{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,2fr) minmax(0,1.2fr) auto;gap:10px;align-items:end}
.wz-start .field{margin:0}
.laeuft{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4em;font:600 .72rem var(--sans);color:var(--warn);background:var(--warn-bg);border-radius:4px;padding:.08em .5em}
.laeuft::before{content:"";width:.6em;height:.6em;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid currentColor;border-right-color:transparent;animation:dreh 1s linear infinite}
@keyframes dreh{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.laeuft::before{animation:none}}
.wz-lauf{padding:24px 6px;display:grid;gap:8px;justify-items:start}
#w-detail{padding:14px 16px;display:grid;gap:12px;align-content:start}
#w-detail .wc-kopf{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;align-items:center}
#w-detail .wc-kopf h3{font-size:1.05rem}
#w-detail .zf{margin:2px 0;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--ink2)}
#w-detail .acts{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#w-detail .wc-gr{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
.stufen{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.stufe{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.35em;font:600 .72rem var(--sans);padding:.12em .55em;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid var(--line2);color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.stufe b{font-weight:700}
.stufe.s1{border-color:var(--err);color:var(--err);background:var(--err-bg)}
.stufe.s2{border-color:var(--warn);color:var(--warn);background:var(--warn-bg)}
.stufe.null{border-color:var(--line);color:var(--faint);background:transparent}
.wz-leist{font-size:.84rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:10px 12px;background:var(--surface2)}
.wz-leist ul{margin:6px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:grid;gap:6px}
.wz-leist small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.76rem}
.pits{display:grid;gap:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);overflow:hidden}
.pit{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface)}
.pit:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.pit summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:grid;grid-template-columns:22px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:8px 10px;font-size:.86rem}
.pit summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.pit summary:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.pit summary i{font-style:normal;font-weight:700;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;font-size:.72rem}
.pit.ok summary i{background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok)}
.pit.nein summary i{background:var(--err-bg);color:var(--err)}
.pit.offen summary i{background:var(--info-bg);color:var(--muted)}
.pit summary .t{min-width:0}

.fps-plan{position:absolute;top:8px;width:0;height:28px;border-left:2px dashed var(--muted)}
.fps-fakten{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px 20px;margin-top:10px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.84rem;color:var(--muted)}
.fps-fakten .rot{color:var(--err);font-weight:600}
.fps-fort{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--ink2)}
.fps-fort .balken{width:132px;margin:0}
.fps.klein{border:0;padding:0;margin:0 0 6px;background:none}
.fps.klein .fps-zt{font-size:1.08rem}.fps.klein .fps-satz{font-size:.86rem}
.fps.klein .fps-linie{height:64px;margin:12px 14px 0 6px}
.fps.klein .fps-fakten{border:0;padding-top:0;margin-top:2px}
/* Hinweis bei Planungsfehlern */
.fp-warn{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px 16px;background:var(--warn-bg);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--warn) 28%,transparent);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 14px;margin:0 0 14px}
.fp-warn p{margin:0;font-size:.88rem;max-width:72ch}
.fp-leer{background:var(--surface);border:1px dashed var(--line2);border-radius:12px;padding:28px 24px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)}
.fp-leer b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:4px}
/* Zeitleiste */
.fp-zeit{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;overflow:auto;max-height:min(76vh,920px);position:relative;overscroll-behavior:contain}
.fpg{position:relative}
.fpg-kopf{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:6;display:flex;background:var(--surface);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.fpg-ecke{position:sticky;left:0;z-index:7;flex:0 0 auto;background:var(--surface);border-right:1px solid var(--line);padding:0 14px 6px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;font:650 .8rem/1.25 var(--sans);color:var(--ink2)}
.fpg-ecke small{font-weight:500;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted)}
.fpg-achse{position:relative;height:50px;flex:0 0 auto}
.fpg-mr{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:26px}
.fpg-mon{position:absolute;top:0;height:26px;border-left:1px solid var(--line2)}
.fpg-mon b{position:sticky;display:inline-block;margin-top:7px;padding:0 6px;font:650 .78rem/1.3 var(--sans);color:var(--ink2);white-space:nowrap;background:var(--surface)}
.fpg-tr{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:26px;height:24px}
.fpg-tg{position:absolute;top:3px;height:17px;text-align:center;font:500 .7rem/17px var(--sans);color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.fpg-tg.we{color:var(--faint);opacity:.75}
.fpg-tg.h{color:var(--btn-ink);background:var(--ink);border-radius:5px;font-weight:700;opacity:1}
.fpg-kw{position:absolute;top:3px;font:500 .7rem/17px var(--sans);color:var(--muted);border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:5px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}
.fpg-hk{position:absolute;top:28px;transform:translateX(-50%);font:700 .64rem/1 var(--sans);color:var(--btn-ink);background:var(--ink);padding:3px 5px;border-radius:4px;pointer-events:none}
.fpg.z-woche .fpg-hk{display:none}
.fpg-rumpf{position:relative}
.fpg-raster{position:absolute;top:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.fpg-we{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;background:var(--fp-tint)}
.fpg-ml{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:1px;background:var(--line)}
.fpg-heute{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;margin-left:-1px;background:var(--ink)}
.fpg-z{display:flex;position:relative}
.fpg-z.ph{background:var(--fp-tint);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.fpg-n{position:sticky;left:0;z-index:4;flex:0 0 auto;align-self:stretch;background:var(--surface);border-right:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;min-width:0}
.fpg-z.ph .fpg-n{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 3.5%,var(--surface))}
.fpg-ph{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;width:100%;border:0;background:none;padding:0 14px 0 10px;font:650 .82rem/1.2 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;text-align:left;min-width:0}
.fpg-ph small{margin-left:auto;font-weight:550;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.fpg-ph .pf{width:1em;color:var(--muted);flex:0 0 auto}
.fpg-t{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;width:100%;border:0;background:none;padding:0 12px 0 27px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;min-width:0;color:var(--ink)}
.fpg-t .tt{display:block;font:560 .84rem/1.25 var(--sans);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.fpg-t .tt .prio{vertical-align:.08em}
.fpg-t small{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.fpg-t:hover .tt{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.fpg-z.erl .fpg-t .tt{color:var(--faint);text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-thickness:1px}
.fpg-s{position:relative;flex:0 0 auto}
/* Balken: Synodos ausgefüllt, Lou Digital mit Rand, Verwaltung schraffiert (wie die Bereichszeichen im Büro) */
.fpb{position:absolute;top:11px;height:18px;border-radius:9px;border:2px solid var(--ink);background:var(--ink);padding:0;cursor:grab;display:flex;align-items:center;box-sizing:border-box;z-index:3;touch-action:none;color:var(--btn-ink)}
.fpb.b-lou{background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink)}
.fpb.b-verwaltung{background-color:var(--surface);background-image:var(--fp-hatch);color:var(--ink)}
.fpb-t{position:relative;z-index:1;padding:0 8px;font:650 .66rem/1 var(--sans);white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;pointer-events:none}
.fpb.b-verwaltung .fpb-t{background:var(--surface);border-radius:4px;margin-left:5px;padding:2px 5px}
.fpb-f{position:absolute;left:-2px;bottom:-5px;height:3px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--ok);pointer-events:none}
.fpb-h{position:absolute;top:-4px;bottom:-4px;width:9px;cursor:ew-resize;z-index:2}
.fpb-h.l{left:-4px}.fpb-h.r{right:-4px}
.fpb.ms{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:3px;transform:rotate(45deg);top:11px;cursor:grab}
.fpb.ms.ziel{width:22px;height:22px;top:9px;background:var(--surface);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--surface),inset 0 0 0 11px var(--ink);border-width:2.5px}
.fpb.st-erledigt{opacity:.36}
.fpb.st-ueber{border-color:var(--err)}.fpb.st-ueber.b-synodos,.fpb.st-ueber.ms{background:var(--err)}
.fpb.st-wartet{border-style:dashed;border-color:var(--warn);color:var(--ink)}
.fpb.st-wartet.b-synodos{background:var(--warn-bg)}
.fpb.st-wartet.b-verwaltung{background-image:var(--fp-hatch-w)}
.fpb.st-blockiert{border-style:dashed}
.fpb.eng:not(.st-erledigt){box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--warn) 30%,transparent)}
.fpb.konf{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--surface),0 0 0 3.5px var(--err)}
.fpb:hover{filter:brightness(1.12)}
.fpb:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:3px}
.fpb.zieht{cursor:grabbing;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.22);z-index:5;transition:none}
.fpg-tip{position:absolute;top:-2px;transform:translate(-50%,-100%);z-index:8;background:var(--ink);color:var(--btn-ink);font:650 .72rem/1 var(--sans);padding:5px 8px;border-radius:6px;white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.fpg-neben{position:absolute;top:11px;display:flex;gap:4px;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap}
.fpg-tag{font:600 .66rem/16px var(--sans);padding:0 .55em;border-radius:999px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.fpg-tag.err{color:var(--err);background:var(--err-bg);border-color:transparent}
.fpg-tag.warn{color:var(--warn);background:var(--warn-bg);border-color:transparent}
.fpg-tag.ziel{color:var(--btn-ink);background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink)}
.fpg-geist{position:absolute;top:12px;height:16px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line2);border-radius:8px;z-index:1;box-sizing:border-box;pointer-events:none}
.fpg-geist.ms{height:14px;top:13px;border-radius:2px;transform:rotate(45deg)}
.fpg-sum{position:absolute;top:13px;height:8px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--line2)}
.fpg-pf{position:absolute;top:0;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;overflow:visible}
.fpg-pf path{fill:none;stroke:var(--muted);stroke-width:1.3;opacity:.55;transition:opacity .12s}
.fpg-pf.hl path{opacity:.14}
.fpg-pf.hl path.an{opacity:1;stroke:var(--ink);stroke-width:1.7}
.fpg-pf.hl path.an.konf{stroke:var(--err)}
.fpg-pf path.erl{stroke:var(--line2)}
.fpg-pf path.konf{stroke:var(--err);stroke-dasharray:4 3}
#fp-pfeil path{fill:var(--muted);stroke:none}#fp-pfeil-k path{fill:var(--err);stroke:none}
/* Liste: nach Fälligkeit, wie eine Strecke von oben nach unten */
.fp-liste{display:grid;gap:18px}
.fpl-g h3,.fpl-g summary{font:650 .92rem/1.2 var(--sans);margin:0 0 8px;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.fpl-g summary{cursor:pointer;list-style-position:inside}
.fpl-g.g-ueber h3{color:var(--err)}
.fpl{position:relative;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:4px 0}
.fpl::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:96px;top:18px;bottom:18px;width:2px;background:var(--line2);border-radius:1px}
.fpl-it{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px 22px minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:0 10px;padding:9px 14px 9px 12px;position:relative}
.fpl-it+.fpl-it{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.fpl-d{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.15}
.fpl-d b{display:block;font-size:.92rem}.fpl-d small{color:var(--muted);font-size:.72rem}
.fpl-pkt{justify-self:center;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);background:var(--surface);position:relative;z-index:1;box-sizing:border-box}
.fpl-it.ms .fpl-pkt{border-radius:3px;transform:rotate(45deg);width:13px;height:13px;background:var(--ink)}
.fpl-it.ziel .fpl-pkt{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;transform:none;border-width:3px;background:var(--surface);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--surface),inset 0 0 0 11px var(--ink)}
.fpl-it.st-erledigt .fpl-pkt{background:var(--ok);border-color:var(--ok)}
.fpl-it.st-ueber .fpl-pkt{border-color:var(--err);background:var(--err-bg)}
.fpl-it.st-wartet .fpl-pkt,.fpl-it.st-blockiert .fpl-pkt{border-color:var(--warn);background:var(--warn-bg);border-style:dashed}
.fpl-it.st-laeuft .fpl-pkt{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ink) 50%,var(--surface) 50%)}
.fpl-t{border:0;background:none;padding:0;text-align:left;min-width:0;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px}
.fpl-t .tt{font-weight:620;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-width:0}
.fpl-t small{font-size:.76rem;color:var(--muted)}
.fpl-t small.fpl-h.warn{color:var(--warn)}.fpl-t small.fpl-h.err{color:var(--err)}
.fpl-t:hover .tt{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.fpl-it.st-erledigt .fpl-t .tt{text-decoration:line-through;color:var(--faint)}
.fpl-r{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;justify-content:flex-end}
.fpst{font:600 .68rem/1.55 var(--sans);padding:0 .58em;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted);background:var(--surface2)}
.fpst.st-erledigt{color:var(--ok);background:var(--ok-bg);border-color:transparent}
.fpst.st-ueber{color:var(--err);background:var(--err-bg);border-color:transparent}
.fpst.st-wartet,.fpst.st-blockiert{color:var(--warn);background:var(--warn-bg);border-color:transparent}
.fpst.st-laeuft,.fpst.st-heute{color:var(--ink);background:var(--surface);border-color:var(--line2)}
/* Bis zum Ziel */
.fp-ziel{margin-top:14px}
.fpz{display:grid}
.fpz-it{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto 96px 128px;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 4px;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:none;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);font:inherit}
.fpz-it:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.fpz-t{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;font-weight:600}
.fpz-t small{color:var(--muted);font-size:.76rem;font-weight:500}
.fpz-b{height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--line);overflow:hidden}
.fpz-b i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--ink);border-radius:inherit}
.fpz-p{font:650 .8rem var(--sans);text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink2)}
.fpz-p.warn{color:var(--warn)}.fpz-p.err{color:var(--err)}
/* Bearbeiten */
.fp-ed-bg{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.28);z-index:60}
.fp-ed{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:min(470px,100vw);background:var(--surface);border-left:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:-12px 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.16);z-index:61;display:flex;flex-direction:column;animation:fpEin .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
@keyframes fpEin{from{transform:translateX(26px);opacity:0}}
.fp-ed-k{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:16px 18px 10px}
.fp-ed-k h2{font-size:1.08rem;margin-right:auto}
.fp-ed-info{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 10px;align-items:center;padding:0 18px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);min-height:6px}
.fp-ed-info .rot{color:var(--err)}.fp-ed-info .warn{color:var(--warn)}
#f-fp{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:14px 18px 18px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 12px;align-content:start}
#f-fp .field.full,#f-fp .full{grid-column:1/-1}
#f-fp .fp-wichtig{margin:2px 0 14px;align-items:flex-start}
#f-fp .fp-wichtig span{margin:0;color:var(--ink);font-size:.86rem}
#f-fp .fp-wichtig small{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);font-size:.74rem;margin-top:1px}
#f-fp .fp-wichtig input{margin-top:3px}
.fp-abh-k{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:5px}
.fp-abh-k span{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}
.fp-abh-k small{color:var(--muted)}
.fp-abh-s{width:100%;padding:.42rem .6rem;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r2) var(--r2) 0 0;background:var(--surface);outline:none;font-size:.86rem;border-bottom:0}
.fp-abh-s:focus{border-color:var(--ink)}
.fp-abh{max-height:210px;overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:0 0 var(--r2) var(--r2);padding:4px 10px 6px;margin-bottom:12px}
.fp-abh fieldset{border:0;margin:0;padding:6px 0 2px}
.fp-abh legend{font:650 .74rem var(--sans);color:var(--muted);padding:0}
.fp-abh-it{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;padding:4px 0;font-size:.85rem;cursor:pointer}
.fp-abh-it input{margin-top:3px}
.fp-abh-it small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.72rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.fp-abh-it.gesperrt{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.fp-ed-f{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding:12px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface2)}
.fp-ed-f .rechts{margin-left:auto}
.fp-ed-f .rot{color:var(--err)}
body.fp-ed-offen{overflow:hidden}
/* Planer: Quelle Fahrplan (Fähnchen) */
.q-fahrplan .q,.q.q-fahrplan{border:0;border-radius:0;background:var(--ink);clip-path:polygon(8% 0,100% 50%,8% 100%)}
/* Übersicht */
#c-fahrplan .fpu{margin-top:8px}
#c-fahrplan .fpu .it{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
#c-fahrplan .fpu .it .t{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
#c-fahrplan .fpu .it .d{flex:0 0 auto;min-width:5.2em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.badge.rot{background:var(--err);color:#fff}
/* Kontakte einordnen */
.einordnen{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px 14px;margin:10px 14px 0;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--warn-bg);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--warn) 26%,transparent)}
.einordnen p{margin:0;font-size:.86rem}
.einordnen.privat{background:var(--surface2);border-color:var(--line)}
.chip.offen{background:var(--warn-bg);color:var(--warn);border-color:transparent}
/* Handy */
@media (max-width:760px){
  .fps{padding:14px 14px 12px}
  .fps-zt{font-size:1.18rem}
  .fps-linie{margin:14px 12px 2px 8px;height:64px}
  .fps-halt:not(.heute):not(.ziel) em{display:none}
  .fpz-it{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto}
  .fpz-b{display:none}.fpz-it .fpst{display:none}
  .fpl-it{grid-template-columns:52px 18px minmax(0,1fr);padding:9px 10px}
  .fpl::before{left:79px}
  .fpl-r{grid-column:3;justify-content:flex-start;margin-top:6px}
  #f-fp{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .fp-ed{width:100vw;border-left:0}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.fp-ed{animation:none}.fps-halt i{transition:none}}
/* Drucken: nur der Fahrplan, quer auf A4 */
@page fahrplan{size:A4 landscape;margin:10mm}
@media print{
  body.druck-fahrplan{background:#fff}
  body.druck-fahrplan .side,body.druck-fahrplan header.top,body.druck-fahrplan .fp-tool,body.druck-fahrplan #fp-bereiche,body.druck-fahrplan #fp-warn,body.druck-fahrplan .fp-ed,body.druck-fahrplan .fp-ed-bg,body.druck-fahrplan #toast,body.druck-fahrplan #toast2,body.druck-fahrplan .view:not(#v-fahrplan){display:none !important}
  body.druck-fahrplan > #app,body.druck-fahrplan .app,body.druck-fahrplan .main-wrap{display:block !important}
  body.druck-fahrplan #v-fahrplan{display:block !important;page:fahrplan}
  body.druck-fahrplan .main-wrap,body.druck-fahrplan main{margin:0 !important;padding:0 !important;max-width:none !important}
  body.druck-fahrplan .fp-zeit{max-height:none;overflow:visible;border:0}
  body.druck-fahrplan .fpg-kopf,body.druck-fahrplan .fpg-n,body.druck-fahrplan .fpg-ecke{position:static}
  body.druck-fahrplan .fps,body.druck-fahrplan .fp-ziel{break-inside:avoid}
  body.druck-fahrplan *{-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}
}
/* ---------- Version 26: Formularschutz ---------- */
.fs-bar{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px 12px;justify-content:space-between;margin:0 0 12px;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface2);font-size:.9rem}
.fs-bar[hidden]{display:none}
.fs-bar .fs-t{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.fs-bar .fs-k{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chip.entwurf{border-style:dashed}
@media print{.fs-bar{display:none !important}}
/* V26 Runde 2: Kartei-Suche mit Status-Filter */
.k-suche{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.k-suche input{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0}
.k-suche select{flex:0 0 auto;width:auto;max-width:44%}
#v-kartei .pane-head .tools{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
/* V26 Runde 5: Kontakte zusammenführen, Firmendaten */
.k-dub{grid-column:1/-1;margin:2px 0 0;padding:8px 12px;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface2)}
.k-zus{margin:0 16px 16px;padding:14px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface2)}
.k-zus h3{margin:0 0 6px}
.k-zus .search{width:100%;margin:6px 0 8px}
.kz-liste{max-height:240px;overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface)}
.kz-liste .conv[aria-pressed=true]{outline:2px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:-2px}
.kz-acts{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
.fd-raster{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,320px),1fr));gap:14px}

#v-team .pane-head .tools{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}

#tm-anzahl{font-weight:500;font-size:.85em;color:var(--muted);margin-left:4px}
