.tm-konto{grid-column:1/-1;margin:-6px 0 10px}

<!-- Anmeldung -->
<section id="gate" class="gate">
 <div class="gate-card">
  <div class="brand"><span class="marks" aria-hidden="true"><svg class="lg syn"><use href="#syn"/></svg><svg class="lg lou"><use href="#lou"/></svg></span><div><b>Büro</b><small>Synodos · Lou Digital</small></div></div>

  <form id="f-login" class="step" autocomplete="on">
   <h1>Anmelden</h1>
   <p>Zugang nur für das Team von Synodos und Lou Digital.</p>
   <label class="field"><span>Benutzername</span><input name="benutzer" autocomplete="username" autocapitalize="none" spellcheck="false" required></label>
   <label class="field"><span>Passwort</span><input name="passwort" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" required></label>
   <button class="btn wide" type="submit">Weiter</button>
   <div class="msg" id="m-login"></div>
   <div class="links small"><button type="button" class="link" data-go="einladung">Einladungscode bekommen? Konto einrichten</button><button type="button" class="link" data-go="reset">Passwort vergessen?</button></div>
  </form>

  <form id="f-einladung" class="step hidden" autocomplete="on">
   <h1>Einladung annehmen</h1>
   <p>Den Einladungscode gibt Ihnen der Admin persönlich. Er gilt 48 Stunden und nur einmal.</p>
   <label class="field"><span>Benutzername</span><input name="benutzer" autocomplete="username" autocapitalize="none" spellcheck="false" required></label>
   <label class="field invite"><span>Einladungscode</span><input name="code" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="characters" spellcheck="false" placeholder="XXXX-XXXX-XXXX" maxlength="14" required></label>
   <label class="field"><span>Neues Passwort (mind. 10 Zeichen)</span><input name="passwort" type="password" autocomplete="new-password" minlength="10" required></label>
   <label class="field"><span>Passwort wiederholen</span><input name="passwort2" type="password" autocomplete="new-password" minlength="10" required></label>
   <button class="btn wide" type="submit">Konto einrichten</button>
   <div class="msg" id="m-einladung"></div>
   <div class="links small"><button type="button" class="link" data-go="login">Zurück zur Anmeldung</button></div>
  </form>

  <form id="f-reset" class="step hidden">
   <h1 id="reset-title">Passwort zurücksetzen</h1>
   <p id="reset-text">Für das Inhaber-Konto kommt ein 6-stelliger Code in den Telegram-Chat „Synodos Büro“. Mitarbeiter bitten den Admin um eine neue Einladung.</p>
   <label class="field"><span>Benutzername</span><input name="benutzer" autocomplete="username" autocapitalize="none" spellcheck="false"></label>
   <div id="reset-step1">
    <button class="btn wide" type="button" id="b-code">Code per Telegram anfordern</button>
   </div>
   <div id="reset-step2" class="hidden">
    <label class="field code"><span>Code aus Telegram</span><input name="code" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]{6}" maxlength="6" autocomplete="one-time-code" placeholder="••••••"></label>
    <label class="field"><span>Neues Passwort (mind. 10 Zeichen)</span><input name="passwort" type="password" autocomplete="new-password" minlength="10"></label>
    <label class="field"><span>Passwort wiederholen</span><input name="passwort2" type="password" autocomplete="new-password" minlength="10"></label>
    <button class="btn wide" type="submit">Passwort festlegen</button>
   </div>
   <div class="msg" id="m-reset"></div>
   <div class="links small"><button type="button" class="link" data-go="login">Zurück zur Anmeldung</button></div>
  </form>

  <form id="f-totp-setup" class="step hidden">
   <h1>Zwei-Faktor einrichten</h1>
   <p>Scannen Sie den Code mit einer Authenticator-App (z. B. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS). Danach den aktuellen 6-stelligen Code eingeben.</p>
   <div class="qr"><canvas id="qr" width="200" height="200" aria-label="QR-Code für die Authenticator-App"></canvas></div>
   <details class="small" style="margin:0 0 14px"><summary>Schlüssel manuell eingeben</summary><p class="secret" id="secret" style="margin:8px 0 0"></p></details>
   <label class="field code"><span>Code aus der App</span><input name="code" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]{6}" maxlength="6" autocomplete="one-time-code" placeholder="••••••" required></label>
   <button class="btn wide" type="submit">Aktivieren und anmelden</button>
   <div class="msg" id="m-totp-setup"></div>
  </form>

  <form id="f-totp" class="step hidden">
   <h1>Code eingeben</h1>
   <p>Den aktuellen 6-stelligen Code aus Ihrer Authenticator-App.</p>
   <label class="field code"><span>Code</span><input name="code" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]{6}" maxlength="6" autocomplete="one-time-code" placeholder="••••••" required></label>
   <button class="btn wide" type="submit">Anmelden</button>
   <div class="msg" id="m-totp"></div>
   <div class="links small"><button type="button" class="link" data-go="login">Abbrechen</button></div>
  </form>
  <footer><span id="g-host">Büro</span> · Zugang nur für Berechtigte · <a id="g-ds" href="/datenschutz.html" rel="noopener">Datenschutz</a></footer>
